_readme: Example rule set. The real one is private and is loaded from the path in CATEGORY_RULES_PATH.
The categories themselves are not defined here: they are read from the database on every run.
A rule only names the category it points to; if that name does not match exactly one leaf
category in the database, the run fails instead of guessing.
Patterns are regular expressions tested against the normalized bank concept
(lowercase, no accents, punctuation collapsed to single spaces). First matching rule wins.
aliasGroups: names the bank and the invoices use for the same supplier, for candidate matching.
promptHints: extra lines appended to the model instructions.
promptHints: Skytickets is always Flights/Hotels, never Activities/Transfers.
